description: A small circular structure on the eastern side of the town, identified via magnetometer survey. It is suggested that it is either a small shrine or round house. No excavations of this feature have been made, so we have no further data to suggest a date range.
bibliography: hertsgeosurvey. “Back to Durobrivae.” Sensing the Iron Age and Roman Past: Geophysics and the Landscape of Hertfordshire (blog), December 10, 2017. https://hertsgeosurvey.wordpress.com/2017/12/10/back-to-durobrivae/.
